result.effectDenial: a passed normalized denial observation requires the exact validated parent and child helper effects; an error, refusal, or exit status cannot create it
result.nativeDenialLog: observed requires one exact helper-process file-write-create record per protected path and one exact network-outbound record per parent and child target; records are consumed once
result.unavailable: empty, malformed, partial, prefixed, duplicated-short, or format-drifted native stderr is recorded as native_denial_log: unavailable while independently observed effect denial remains explicit
result.configuration: the canonical evidence binds the exact driver binary identity, effective configuration, helper-bound configuration, and original probe envelope
result.correlation: the opaque probe execution retains driver and probe identity; normalization and project launch both reject cross-binary or cross-envelope reuse
result.retention: canonical evidence contains only bounded identity, digests, statuses, booleans, and counts; raw stderr, filesystem paths, environment values, and secrets are absent
result.projection: zero, mutated, cross-binary, cross-configuration, and cross-probe evidence cannot project a passed posture observation
result.tests: focused count-25, package, race, all-assurance, full CLI module, vet, format, and Darwin/Linux/Windows compile-only checks passed
result.independentReview: approved the final exact-record parser, one-to-one parent/child accounting, opaque correlation, bounded canonical evidence, and unavailable-evidence behavior; no reviewer writes

limits: This task proves source and local test behavior. It did not execute Codex, Seatbelt, a project command, the Mastra SDK, a receiver, a provider/model request, production coordinates, or an external control-plane operation.
Native denial-log format drift deliberately becomes unavailable rather than guessed. The exact live Codex tuple must still reproduce the expected records before support qualification.
Platform identity is not inferred by this normalizer. SE-03-10 must bind the observed platform with the exact binary/config/probe evidence before publishing a supported or rejected tuple.
Raw native logs are neither retained nor hashed. Only normalized, path-free facts enter the evidence digest.
Cleanup and maximum-process enforcement remain separate Phase 03 exit gates.
